summary: Sprott Physical Copper Trust filed a Form 6-K with a July 29, 2026 press release announcing an updated at-the-market (ATM) equity program to issue up to US$250 million of Units in Canada and the US, replacing its prior ATM program from May 4, 2026. Sales will occur through agents including Cantor, Virtu, BMO, and Canaccord at prevailing market prices on NYSE Arca and TSX. Proceeds will fund physical copper acquisitions. This is a routine capital-raising update, not a special situation.
